result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store, my recommendation would be **Stripe**, with **PayPal offered as an additional checkout option**\.

However, the best choice depends on your website platform, where your customers are based, and how much you sell.

Assuming you're operating in the UK, here's how I'd compare the main options in November 2026.

## Best payment processors for small businesses

![Für Hello Kitty Fans - Mibrix](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tOiZ9v22mWkKDkODjZ-v8UmHuYEacS351-fhJlicedtzRtyvIPyT0LbHRVsov1FwCqimbt2M5XbGmMjfcFRqoBnSC867jR1vj2Q9kN8GWqWxrNowdJCqgKFlsNcxOvUQZiEoQ3wUV3e9Iv-ULg-8O_uiwrVTYdmAuanbvrKZ5q48tOAeoqXUh_tpwPm1cZkj?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

Best for WooCommerce, custom websites and growing stores

- UK card fees: approximately 1.5% + 20p
- No monthly fee on standard pricing
- Apple Pay, Google Pay and card payments
- Excellent integrations and fraud protection

Website: [Stripe UK](https://stripe.com/gb)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. PayPal**

(Best additional option)

Best for customer familiarity and trust

- Approximately 2.9% + 30p for domestic transactions
- Customers can pay using their PayPal balance or cards
- Recognised internationally
- Easy to add to most online stores

Website: [PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/uk/business)

---

![Square, Inc Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/o-iRI2kybznmyDubdZ44gVK-vjE6gDKLVakQnJxlACGxko3Nj1jIpWaBRdIuWDcPvStz6IZe1O-k-UExmpEW7lDQ_S559qV-l4JT0xhrWDjCbTjdZDVgBDFR6LW32FKPeauHAWGYSuEdhn0AMiHDAZFaPUNLlmIzwiGcOc7OZzuhVnlNs80uSa8gb9GbKVsf?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Square**

Best for online and physical shops

- UK online card fees: approximately 1.4% + 25p
- Free basic online store options
- Easy setup
- Combines online and in-person payments

Website: [Square UK](https://squareup.com/gb/en)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Shopify Payments**

Best if your store uses Shopify

- Integrated directly into Shopify
- No separate payment gateway setup
- Simplifies refunds and reporting
- Pricing depends on your Shopify subscription

Website: [Shopify Payments UK](https://www.shopify.com/uk/payments)

---

![Mollie pinautomaat kosten (2026) · gratis vergelijken](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/D57_7d7oSy02s6yl1zjAav-Yxgf4LUZZPYDHYzFt_wNqCHlBqkrhAHplhYfBTJOJy91u1bEQYVbEZXh_gEzRP8VoyGIrNDZVtuNQGJCvwJQrSLcgSZ7d7a0ve45WpqW-VHK_GV5JgM8myiK1AujLCh4qHlURg2gBe2EoWYpui5Qphgo8QfSPgrRjtevRCmLH?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Mollie**

Best for European customers

- Competitive European card processing rates
- Supports multiple payment methods
- No standard monthly subscription
- Good ecommerce integrations

Website: [Mollie](https://www.mollie.com/)

The indicative UK rates above are based on published comparisons; check each provider's pricing and eligibility before signing up. For a typical small online shop, I'd start with\:

| Payment method | Purpose |
|--------|--------|
| Stripe | Main card processor |
| PayPal | Additional checkout option |
| Apple Pay / Google Pay | Faster mobile checkout |


This gives customers flexibility without making your payment setup unnecessarily complicated.
